title: A New Bike Shop
text:
Our local magazine visited a new bike shop in the town centre. The shop sells bikes for children and adults. The owner, Anna, repairs bikes in the back room. Customers can also rent a bike for one day.

Anna says that many people want to ride to work this year. She has ordered more helmets and lights for the winter. Her favourite part of the job is helping a child learn to ride. The shop opens every day except Monday.

questions.text: Where is the new bike shop located?
options: On the main road out of town

questions.text: What does Anna order for the winter?
What can the reader conclude about the bike shop?
options: It is popular with many different customers
It is only open for a short time each year
It is hard for children to visit

questions.text: What does Anna probably enjoy most about her job?
options: Working alone in the back room

vocabulary.definition: pays to use something for a period of time
hard hats that protect the head when riding

paragraph_translations: Nasz lokalny magazyn odwiedził nowy sklep rowerowy w centrum miasta. Sklep sprzedaje rowery dla dzieci i dorosłych. Właścicielka, Anna, naprawia rowery w pokoju z tyłu. Klienci mogą też wypożyczyć rower na jeden dzień.

Anna mówi, że w tym roku wiele osób chce jeździć rowerem do pracy. Zamówiła więcej kasków i świateł na zimę. Jej ulubiona część pracy to pomaganie dziecku w nauce jazdy. Sklep jest otwarty codziennie oprócz poniedziałku.
